verdict.rationale: Vendor docs claim an official Logseq Sync service that syncs up to 10 graphs across Desktop/Android/iOS and is end-to-end encrypted (logseq-docs-10, logseq-docs-28), but hands-on community reports contradict reliability and maturity: sync was gated behind a paid sponsor tier and described as buggy ('wouldn't rely on it yet'), and another user reports paying to support sync efforts but seeing nothing usable for years, calling the overall sync story 'clunky'. missing for 10: independent verification that E2E encryption is implemented as claimed, evidence of stable/production-grade sync (not beta), and confirmation sync issues from comm-5/comm-8 have been resolved.
